#include <stdio.h>
int main(void) { int a, b; if (scanf("%d %d", &a, &b) != 2) return 2; printf("%d\n", a + b); return 0; }

#include <stdio.h>
int main(void) { int sum = 0; for (int i = 1; i <= 5; ++i) sum += i; printf("%d\n", sum); return 0; }

#include <stdio.h>
int main(void) { printf("pi=%.2f count=%04d char=%c\n", 3.14159, 7, 'A'); return 0; }

#include <stdio.h>
int main(void) { int value, sum = 0; while (scanf("%d", &value) == 1) sum += value; printf("%d\n", sum); return 0; }

#include <stdio.h>
int main(void) { int matrix[2][3] = {{1, 2, 3}, {4, 5, 6}}; int sum = 0; for (int row = 0; row < 2; ++row) for (int col = 0; col < 3; ++col) sum += matrix[row][col]; printf("%d\n", sum); return 0; }

#include <stdio.h>
int main(void) { unsigned value = 5u; printf("%u %u\n", value << 2, value & 3u); return 0; }
